steps.description: Load the module, call createScene(), then immediately call updateMatrixWorld(true)

failure_patterns.reason: ❌ CRITICAL: Call root.updateMatrixWorld(true) immediately after createScene() before reading any matrixWorld — stale transforms cause large geometry errors.

suggestions: Pattern: const root = createScene(); root.updateMatrixWorld(true); — these two calls must be adjacent.

steps.description: Treat named THREE.Group nodes as parts/links
Assign each mesh to its nearest named ancestor group
Bake world transforms into geometry: applyMatrix4(matrixWorld) then toNonIndexed()

failure_patterns.reason: ⚠️ The skill-provided export_link_objs.mjs is missing toNonIndexed() after applyMatrix4(). Write your own export script with correct baking to avoid Chamfer distance errors >1.0.
❌ CRITICAL: After applyMatrix4(mesh.matrixWorld), you MUST call toNonIndexed() if geometry has an index. Missing this causes OBJExporter to produce wrong face indices (Chamfer >1.0).
❌ CRITICAL: Do NOT clone meshes into a group for export — this preserves local transforms. Bake geometry with applyMatrix4(matrixWorld) + toNonIndexed() instead.

suggestions: Baking: geom = mesh.geometry.clone(); geom.applyMatrix4(mesh.matrixWorld); if (geom.index) geom = geom.toNonIndexed();
warnings: Never skip toNonIndexed() — OBJExporter silently produces wrong vertex indices with indexed BufferGeometry, causing Chamfer distance errors >1.0.

steps.description: Export per-part OBJ using deterministic (sorted) part ordering

failure_patterns.reason: ⚠️ Sort part names before iterating for export — unsorted iteration is non-deterministic and causes verifier failures.

suggestions: Sort parts by name with localeCompare before exporting: Array.from(parts.values()).sort((a,b) => a.group.name.localeCompare(b.group.name)).
